news.headline: Fantasy football Week 6 inactives: Williams to play; Hurts, Jackson ruled out
news.description: Updated inactives and analysis based on the latest reports and official announcements leading up to kickoff.

news.headline: Ranking the top 10 rookie performances in Super Bowl history
news.description: Which rookies made a name from themselves in the Super Bowl over the years? We listed 10 standout performances, plus honorable mentions.

news.headline: 49ers rule out Bosa for Monday, still hopeful for Evans, Juszczyk
news.description: The San Francisco 49ers will have to wait at least another week for the return of defensive end Nick Bosa, though there's at least a chance they'll have both receiver Mike Evans and fullback Kyle Juszczyk for Monday's game vs. the Washington Commanders.

news.headline: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts on IR due to blood clot, expected to be out indefinitely
news.description: The Eagles have placed Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with numerous doctors and experts, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

news.headline: Patriots activate WR A.J. Brown for Sunday's game vs. Jets
news.description: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown was activated from injured reserve Saturday after missing the past four games with a right high ankle sprain, the team announced.

news.headline: Sources: Eagles' Jalen Hurts, out indefinitely with blood clot, not planned for IR
news.description: The Eagles are not planning to put Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, sources told ESPN, even as he remains sidelined indefinitely with a superficial blood clot.

news.headline: Eagles' Saquon Barkley ruled out; DeVonta Smith likely to return
news.description: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers with a hamstring injury, but it appears WR DeVonta Smith will return.

news.headline: Packers' Josh Jacobs eligible to return next week amid investigation
news.description: Packers RB Josh Jacobs will be removed from the commissioner exempt list Monday, the league announced, making him eligible to practice and play next week.

news.headline: Where is the Tennessee Titans' pass rush?
news.description: The Titans invested more in the defensive front than any other area when Robert Saleh took over. So far, there hasn't been a significant ROI.

news.headline: Jalen Hurts' health bigger than football, as teammates, coach detail QB concern
news.description: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni declined to offer much detail about Jalen Hurts' health, instead focusing on his connection with the quarterback.

news.headline: Seahawks sticking with Sam Darnold as starter despite INTs
news.description: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald is standing behind Sam Darnold as the team's starting quarterback despite his seven interceptions over the past four games.
